Priya (AE): FYI — ACME wants an air-gapped POC. Main asks: signed offline bundle, deterministic upgrades (no surprise auto-push), monthly or quarterly cadence, and an ops runbook. Kickoff Wed 10am PT. Can we confirm feasibility and pricing options?
Tom (SE): +1. Need to know model size + quantization target. For a typical 13B quantized to 4-bit we're ~1.1GB for the model artifact; full operator bundle with runtime =~1.6GB. That affects USB vs network delivery. :thinking_face:
Jules (Infra Eng): Certs/KMS note — for private we support customer-managed KMS but offline installs require a signing key we provide (or we can accept customer-signed artifacts if legal ok). Root CA rotation offline is manual.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Commercial side: they asked about upgrade cadence impact on support SLAs and cost. Do we price per-reserved-capacity + on-prem license or a flat annual platform fee? They mentioned procurement constraints (monthly billing hard).
Priya (AE): They also flagged security questionnaire items around SBOM, image provenance, and signing. Who can own answers for SBOM and signing chain?
Tom (SE): I can handle SBOM/signing answers. Quick examples:
```
- Model artifact: model-v1.2.q4.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...) ~1.1GB
- Runtime bundle: redwood-runtime-2026.03.tar.gz (sha256: def456...) ~0.5GB
Upgrade path: baseline -> delta patches (recommended) or full bundle replace.
```
Jules (Infra Eng): For delta patches: we support chunked minibundles. Constraints: patching requires operator privileges and ephemeral staging cluster. Offline patching process: 1) transfer bundle, 2) validate signature, 3) run `rwinstall --offline-apply <bundle>` on airgapped jumpbox. No automatic rollback — operator must trigger.
Priya (AE): Can we offer a managed cadence: monthly security patches + quarterly model updates? They prefer predictable windows (e.g., first Tue each month).
Tom (SE): Yes. We can commit to a scheduled monthly patch window for Dedicated/Private under an SOW. For air-gapped we do signed minibundles and a documented runbook.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Pricing options to propose: (A) Reserved capacity + private deployment fee + per-update engineering retainer; (B) One-off license + paid support hours for each offline bundle. Which do we prefer to present?
Jules (Infra Eng): Operational blockers to flag to customer: limited bandwidth for large bundles, need for an ops person to run installs, and cryptographic key custody decisions. If they insist on customer-managed signing keys we need an offboarding checklist.
Priya (AE): Customer asked whether we can slim the bundle (model-only minibundle) to reduce transfer size. Tom — feas?
Tom (SE): Feasible: offer 3 flavors — full bundle (~1.6GB), runtime+model (~1.2GB), model-only (~1.1GB). If they want smaller, we could ship a quantized model (q4->q2) but that affects perf/quality and we'd need eval signoff.
deploy-bot: New ticket created: SAL-1427 — "ACME air-gapped POC - packaging & cadence" assigned to Tom, Lena.
Lena (Solutions Eng): Action items: I'll draft two commercial proposals (A & B) and a sample SOW language for monthly maintenance windows.
Tom (SE): Action: I'll produce a minibundle size table + example `rwinstall` offline command and a short runbook snippet by EOD.
Jules (Infra Eng): Action: I'll confirm HSM/KMS constraints and whether customer-managed signing key process needs Legal signoff (ETA 48h).
Priya (AE): Perfect. I'll share these with ACME before Wed and set the kickoff. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
